component.name: ISOpropyl
component.summary: Write and inspect bootable USB images safely

description.p: ISOpropyl is a graphical Linux utility for creating bootable USB and SD media. It supports byte-for-byte disk images and filesystem-aware UEFI FAT32 or verified UEFI:NTFS workflows while emphasizing target identity checks, clear erase confirmations, cancellation, logging, and read-back verification.

It can inspect common boot layouts, calculate and compare checksums, stream compressed and virtual disk images, inspect and select Windows WIM/ESD editions, customize supported Windows installers, save raw drive or optical-disc images, restore ordinary data storage, and run explicitly separated destructive media tests.

screenshot.caption: Inspect an image, choose a protected removable target, and select DD or ISO mode.

description.p: Initial alpha with DD and UEFI FAT32/UEFI:NTFS ISO writing, image analysis, Windows edition selection and customization, drive backup, formatting, erasure, and media testing.
